notes.title: Steam Next Fest | Demo Update
notes.notes:
A warm welcome to all the new players joining us as part of the Steam Next Fest! 🚀 We monitor your feedback closely and have already implemented the first batch of improvements! Many of you have asked for additional language support, and we are happy to announce that the demo has received an update that addresses these requests! The game is now available in:
[list][*] French
[*] German
[*] Korean
[*] Polish
[*] Russian
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Spanish
[*] Japanese[/list]
📝 We want to hear your impressions: share your thoughts in reviews as well as in our communities on Steam or Discord, and this will help us make the game even better!

notes.title: Demo Version Released and Festival Participation!
notes.notes:
As promised, we are back with more news! The Dark Moon test has recently ended, and many people were hopefully able to get acquainted with a portion of our upcoming title. But, if you could not participate for whatever reason or were left wanting more, then this message is for you – we are happy to announce the launching of the demo version for our project! Everyone shall now have an opportunity to land and fight for survival on the Earth's satellite!

[previewyoutube=0MgGgHTblFQ;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3407640

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350847/98906a3b0c6175915002c53c43e5707aa952aeea.png[/img]
We would also like to inform you that the RTS Fest has started on Steam, and that Dark Moon is participating in it!

Add the game to your wishlist and join [url=https://discord.com/invite/Dbd6Jz7qG7]our Discord server[/url], to stay up-to-date with the project's progress!
